snippet.title: "Tron Deadly Discs" for the Mattel Aquarius Computer
snippet.description: This video is "Tron Deadly Discs" for the Mattel Electronics Aquarius computer.  This is one of my least favorite Mattel developed games.  They could have put more effort into the appearance, but that's small compared to the missing Recognizers.  Where did they go?  It gets boring running around "derezzing" the bad guys all the time.  I do like Tron's shield, though.  Also, the use of the AY sound chip is appreciated, unlike NightStalker and AD&D, though a sample of the Tron theme song would have been nice.
